caption: A woodcutter with a long handled axe chops down a thick tree in a forest.
positive_analysis:
The axe blade strikes the exposed wood notch, deepening the cut into the tree trunk.
As the cut widens, the remaining wood at the base weakens, reducing structural support.
Gravity pulls the unbalanced mass above the cut, causing the tree to tilt and fall.
positive_relations: The axe blade strikes the exposed wood notch, deepening the cut into the tree trunk.

negative_analysis:
The swinging axe head approaching the trunk notch -> impact drives the blade deeper into the exposed wood.
Repeated strikes removing wood fibers -> the notch widens and deepens progressively.
The man's forward swing posture -> transfers force into the trunk at the cut face.
Moss and root mass at the base -> remain undisturbed as the cutting continues.
